rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Dash
rules.description: Once per round, at the end of this unit's activation, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

rules.name: Dash Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Dash. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Disintegrate
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Tough(9) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+2).

rules.name: Dodge
rules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they aren't Fatigued, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls in melee against them.

rules.name: Enhanced Fortified
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Fortified, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Fortified (instead of only AP(-1)).

rules.name: Enhanced Guardian
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Guardian, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Guardian (instead of only AP(-1)).

rules.name: Enhanced Guardian Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Guardian. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Fortified
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

rules.name: Guardian
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

rules.name: Hit & Run
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

rules.name: Hit & Run Shooter
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting.

rules.name: Hit & Run Shooter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Hit & Run Shooter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Piercing Target
rules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking them.

rules.name: Ranged Shrouding
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting, that enemy unit gets -4" range to a min. of 6".

rules.name: Ranged Shrouding Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ranged Shrouding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Regeneration Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Shred
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

rules.name: Shred when Shooting Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shred on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Steadfast
rules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

rules.name: Steadfast Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Steadfast. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Stealth
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Stealth Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Unstoppable in Melee Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Versatile Expert
rules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) on their weapons, or get +1 to hit rolls.

spells.name: Dread Strike
spells.effect: Pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which takes 1 hit with AP(2) and Disintegrate. This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].

spells.name: Focused Defender
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Unpredictable Fighter once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Guardian Protection
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Enhanced Guardian once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Mind Gash
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with Shred.

spells.name: The Founder's Curse
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Shred on their weapons when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Thunderous Mist
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits.
